description:
AptiStockX is a cross-platform desktop stock charting and portfolio research app.

AptiStockX is a cross-platform desktop stock charting and portfolio research app with a global symbol catalog, local watchlists, chart workspaces, technical indicators, drawing studies, portfolio tracking, and downloadable market data.
AptiStockX 3.1 adds global market support with a searchable symbol catalog and dockable Global Market Stock Viewer, verified catalog updates, new line-study tools, and chart-rendering fixes.
